summary.business_type: Utility / free web tool (single-purpose, ad-monetised, 9 locales)
top_findings: Cloudflare managed robots.txt serves Disallow: / to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider and meta-externalagent
og-image.png returns 404 while being referenced by og:image and twitter:image on all 45 pages
favicon.svg and favicon.ico return 404; source files are named 'favicon copy.svg' and 'favicon copy.ico'
FAQPage JSON-LD is emitted between <!DOCTYPE html> and <html>, pushing meta charset past the 1024-byte window
Site is only 5 unique templates; no informational content targets the long-tail its own H2s name
quick_wins: git mv 'public/favicon copy.svg' public/favicon.svg and the .ico likewise
Move the FAQPage script inside <Layout> in IndexPage.astro:98
Unblock retrieval AI agents in the Cloudflare AI Crawl Control dashboard
Trim 6 titles over 60 chars and 4 descriptions over 160 chars in src/i18n/*.ts

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 45 sitemap URLs return HTTP 200 with no redirect chains
Self-referencing canonical verified on every page
http -> 301 -> https; /about -> 308 -> /about/
pages.dev preview host serves X-Robots-Tag: noindex
Retired blog URLs 301 correctly to locale home pages
Hreflang complete and reciprocal across all 45 URLs with x-default

findings.title: JSON-LD emitted before <html>
findings.description: A ~5KB script sits between <!DOCTYPE html> and <html> at byte offset 5. Parsers relocate it, but <meta charset> lands at ~5030 bytes, outside the 1024-byte scan window. Saved only by the charset=utf-8 HTTP header.
findings.recommendation: Move the JSON-LD block inside <Layout> in src/components/IndexPage.astro:98

findings.title: www host returns 200 instead of 301
findings.description: https://www.noisedecibelmeter.com/ serves a full 200 response. Mitigated by a correct cross-host canonical to the apex, but splits crawl budget.
findings.recommendation: Add a Cloudflare bulk redirect from www to apex

findings.title: No Strict-Transport-Security header
findings.description: Only x-content-type-options and referrer-policy are set.
findings.recommendation: Add HSTS via public/_headers

findings.title: No CSP or Permissions-Policy
findings.description: A microphone-based tool has a natural case for an explicit Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add Permissions-Policy: microphone=(self), camera=(), geolocation=()

findings.title: Sitemap lacks xhtml:link hreflang annotations
findings.description: On-page hreflang is correct, so this is redundancy rather than a defect.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add xhtml:link alternates to sitemap.xml

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage carries ~1060 words across 7 H2 sections and 15 FAQ entries
Answers are specific and numeric (OSHA 2h at 100 dB, WHO <40 dB night, plus/minus 2-3 dB accuracy)
Honest about limits versus certified ISO 61672 hardware
Locale content parity holds; ja/zh char counts match normal CJK compression and section structure is identical

findings.title: Only 5 unique templates exist
findings.description: No page targets 'decibel chart', 'how loud is X', or OSHA/WHO threshold queries, despite the homepage H2s naming those topics.
findings.recommendation: Build a small informational layer in English first; validate in GSC before translating

findings.title: No authorship or source citations
findings.description: Content quotes OSHA, WHO and ISO 61672 but links to none of them, and no author or organisation is named anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add outbound citations and a named maintainer with stated expertise

findings.title: Thin about and contact pages
findings.description: /contact/ is ~112 words, /about/ ~280.
findings.recommendation: Expand with substantive detail on who runs the tool and how it works

findings.title: H1 concatenates without a space in extracted text
findings.description:
Renders as 'Online decibel meter.Real-time sound levels.' because of a
with no surrounding whitespace. Visually fine; that is the string crawlers and LLMs read.
findings.recommendation: Add a space, or split into separate elements

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Exactly one H1 on all 45 pages
Unique titles and descriptions per locale, no cross-locale duplication
Complete OG and Twitter card tag sets

findings.title: Six titles exceed the ~60 char SERP limit
findings.description: ru 80, es 79, en 77, pt 73, it 71, fr 66 characters.
findings.recommendation: Trim title values in src/i18n/*.ts

findings.title: Four descriptions exceed ~160 chars
findings.description: es 202, it 198, pt 197, fr 195 characters.
findings.recommendation: Trim description values in src/i18n/*.ts

findings.title: About and contact titles are near-empty of intent
findings.description: /about/ title is 27 chars, /contact/ is 29.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to include the brand and a qualifying term

findings.title: ja and zh descriptions are short
findings.description: ja 75 and zh 52 characters, short even allowing for CJK density.
findings.recommendation: Expand toward the CJK equivalent of ~120 chars

findings.title: Obsolete meta keywords tag
findings.description: Present on every page. Ignored by all engines.
findings.recommendation: Remove from Layout.astro

findings.title: Internal linking is nav and footer only
findings.description: 14 links, zero contextual. Largely a consequence of having only 5 pages.
findings.recommendation: Resolves naturally once the informational layer exists

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD that parses cleanly on all pages
WebApplication correctly declares offers.price 0, applicationCategory and a real featureList
FAQPage covers all 15 on-page questions with matching visible content

findings.title: WebApplication emitted on non-application pages
findings.description: Present on /privacy-policy/, /terms/, /contact/ and /about/, which are not the application.
findings.recommendation: Gate the WebApplication node to the tool page only

findings.title: No Organization or WebSite node
findings.description: Nothing establishes the publisher entity for search engines or AI systems.
findings.recommendation: Add site-wide Organization (name, url, logo) and WebSite nodes

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList on sub-pages
findings.description: Four sub-pages have no breadcrumb markup.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList to about, contact, privacy-policy and terms

findings.title: FAQPage no longer yields a Google rich result
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 7 May 2026. The markup is still valid and still describes the page to non-Google consumers.
findings.recommendation: Keep it; do not expect SERP real estate from it

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop LCP 640ms on h1.hero-h1; mobile LCP 424ms on p.hero-body
CLS 0.0016 desktop and 0 mobile
TTFB 275ms desktop and 206ms mobile

findings.title: Desktop TBT of 1165ms
findings.description: Main-thread time from AdSense and GTM, against 0ms on mobile. TBT is the lab proxy for INP, and this page's core interaction is a button tap.
findings.recommendation: Delay AdSense init until first interaction or requestIdleCallback

findings.title: 19 of 25 requests are third-party
findings.description: Twelve distinct hosts: AdSense, DoubleClick, adtrafficquality x2, GTM, Google Fonts x2, Cloudflare Insights, ProductHunt, toolfame, sellwithboost.
findings.recommendation: Self-host fonts and badges to cut cross-origin connections

findings.title: Google Fonts loaded cross-origin
findings.description: fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com sit on the critical path.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the two font files

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: FAQ answers are specific, numeric and genuinely citable
PerplexityBot and OAI-SearchBot are not named in the block list, so they fall through to Allow: /

findings.title: Blanket AI crawler block at the CDN
findings.description: Cloudflare managed robots.txt serves Disallow: / to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider and meta-externalagent, plus Content-Signal: ai-train=no. The repo's public/robots.txt is clean and is being overridden at the edge.
findings.recommendation: Decide the posture deliberately in Cloudflare AI Crawl Control; consider allowing retrieval agents while keeping bulk scrapers blocked

findings.title: og:image 404s, so every LLM and social unfurl renders blank
findings.description: All 45 pages reference a missing 1200x630 image.
findings.recommendation: Ship public/og-image.png

findings.title: No Organization entity for AI systems to attach a brand to
findings.description: No consistent name/url/logo triple exists in structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema

findings.title: FAQ answers are not individually addressable
findings.description: 15 answers sit inside <summary> elements rather than headings. Indexable, but with no h3 anchor structure for passage extraction.
findings.recommendation: Wrap each summary question in an h3

findings.title: No /llms.txt
findings.description: Optional and ignored by Google Search. Cheap for a 5-page site.
findings.recommendation: Add after the crawler posture is resolved; pointless while agents are disallowed

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text present and descriptive on all 3 homepage images
Only 3 images total, so image weight is not a performance factor

findings.title: og-image.png returns 404
findings.description: Referenced by og:image and twitter:image on all 45 pages and declared 1200x630, but the file does not exist in public/.
findings.recommendation: Create and deploy public/og-image.png

findings.title: favicon.svg and favicon.ico return 404
findings.description: Source files exist as 'favicon copy.svg' and 'favicon copy.ico'; the literal space-copy in the filename breaks both references.
findings.recommendation: git mv both files to the names Layout.astro already references

findings.title: All homepage images hot-linked from third parties
findings.description: toolfame.com, api.producthunt.com and sellwithboost.com. External render dependency and a privacy leak.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the three badge assets

findings.title: Badge images lack dimensions and lazy loading
findings.description: No width, height or loading attribute. Measured CLS is ~0 today but nothing prevents regression.
findings.recommendation: Add width, height and loading=lazy

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Rename 'favicon copy.svg' and 'favicon copy.ico' to favicon.svg and favicon.ico (2 min)
Move FAQPage JSON-LD inside <Layout> in IndexPage.astro:98 (5 min)
Decide AI crawler posture in Cloudflare AI Crawl Control (30 min)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Trim 6 over-length titles and 4 over-length descriptions in src/i18n/*.ts (1 hr)
301 www to apex via Cloudflare bulk redirect (10 min)
Fix schema typing: gate WebApplication, add Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList (1 hr)
Reduce third-party main-thread cost; self-host fonts and badges (2-4 hrs)
Add HSTS and Permissions-Policy headers (20 min)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Build the informational layer: decibel chart, 'how loud is X', OSHA/WHO reference
Add outbound citations and a named author with stated expertise (2 hrs)
Wrap FAQ summary questions in h3 for passage extraction (1 hr)
Add /llms.txt once crawler posture is resolved (15 min)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Verify apex and www in Search Console; watch retired /blog/* drop from Coverage
Track CrUX field INP monthly; it is the metric most at risk from AdSense
Re-run this audit after Phase 2; expect 66 -> ~82 from Phases 1-2 alone
Monthly: query ChatGPT and Perplexity for 'free online decibel meter' and log citation presence
